subject.title: fix(openrouter): apply request policy to music generation requests

question: Should OpenRouter music generation honor an explicit models.providers.openrouter.request.allowPrivateNetwork setting, or must this capability always deny private-network destinations even when the provider policy enables them?
rationale: Source and proof establish that the patch works, but repository evidence does not settle whether music generation is intentionally exempt from the otherwise configurable provider transport policy.

options.title: Honor explicit operator policy
options.body: Merge the current behavior so music generation follows the sanitized provider request policy while remaining deny-by-default when no opt-in is configured.

options.title: Retain the music hard denial
options.body: Keep allowPrivateNetwork disabled for music generation while forwarding only request-policy fields that do not broaden destination reach.

recommendation.title: Honor explicit operator policy
recommendation.body: Merge the current behavior so music generation follows the sanitized provider request policy while remaining deny-by-default when no opt-in is configured.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available OpenRouter provider-policy routing signal in the PR timeline.
